decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The CRD artifacts for v2.14.5 [ev-d9606f97c234] and v3.0.0 [ev-f69c10f943ee] were checked deterministically. The validators confirmed that spec.syncWindows[].andOperator exists only in the target AppProject v1alpha1 schema. So the subject and change are concrete: one schema field was added to the AppProject CRD. For a purely additive field, the canonical added/none rule (also confirmed) gives no consequence for existing environments, so an engineer can write the applicability: any environment that applies the AppProject CRD gets the field, with no effect unless it is used. Confidence is low because the excerpts shown are only the apiVersion lines, and the evidence never says what andOperator does.
